apps.name: Soccer Stats
apps.subtitle: Track goals, assists, and match stats
apps.localizedDescription: Track your player’s goals, assists, and match stats across seasons, and score games live from the sideline.

versions.localizedDescription:
- On the home page, Other games cards just show their period (e.g. "Fall
  2026"), since the section is already called Other games

- Seasons on the home page show an icon for their period instead of a
  soccer ball: 🍂 Fall, ❄️ Winter, 🌱 Spring, ☀️ Summer. Other games use
  their period's icon on indigo; tournaments keep 🏆. A team photo still
  replaces the icon

- Fixed: tournaments showed as regular seasons, each one-off game started a
  new "Other games" group, and the game clock ignored your minutes per half
- One-off games are grouped by season period, e.g. "Other games · Fall
  2026". The group is made automatically the first time and reused after
  that, so there are never duplicates
- Moving a game always offers the Other games group for that game's date,
  even if it doesn't exist yet
- New Summer period for seasons (June–July; Spring is March–May)

- Other games (one-off games) are now grouped in boxes by the team your
  player played for, each with its own record, e.g. "Indiana Elite Chicago
  · 2 games · 1W 1L". Slightly different spellings of a team go together
- Moving a game into Other games keeps who it was played for. A guest game
  moved there uses its guest team as "Playing for"

- Move a game to another season: open the game and tap "Move to another
  season…" at the bottom. The score, stats and play-by-play go with it.
  Handy for games your player played for another team: make a season for
  that team and move them there. A moved guest game stops being marked as
  a guest game

apps.name: Soccer Stats Beta
apps.subtitle: Test builds of upcoming features
apps.localizedDescription: Test builds of Soccer Stats with features that aren’t released yet. Installs alongside the normal app.

versions.localizedDescription: New Live Activity look (app name, LIVE/FINAL, logos), game clock with minutes per half, opponent logos.
Tap the live score to open the scoring screen. After Done, the final score stays on the lock screen for 30 minutes.
Fix: the live score code wasn't connected. The scoring screen now shows a small 'Live:' status next to Done.
